evals.expected_output: Should route to ship-it. Should not route to clean-sweep or map-it.

Names terminal states BUILT / PROMOTION_READY / RELEASED / DEPLOYED_AND_VERIFIED
Does not route to clean-sweep or map-it

evals.prompt: SPEC.md is our frozen spec for slugify. Implement it.
evals.expected_output: Should enter at the frozen-spec branch (VALIDATE, then DECOMPOSE) without re-grilling, decompose into tracer-bullet slices, and map every acceptance criterion to a passing test in a TRACEABILITY table on the BASE head. The frozen spec is the contract: AC-2 (transliterating accented letters) is not dropped or reworded to make BUILT reachable; an unmet criterion is unmet work, not a waiver. The existing AC-1 test is kept.
assertions: Recognizes the frozen-spec entry and does not re-grill it
Maps AC-1 and AC-2 to passing tests in a TRACEABILITY table
Treats an unmet criterion as unmet work rather than editing the spec

# slugify (FROZEN 2026-09-01, v1)

- AC-1: lowercases and joins words with single hyphens: "Hello  World" -> "hello-world".
- AC-2: transliterates accented Latin letters: "Crème Brûlée" -> "creme-brulee".

workspace_state.why: a frozen spec is the contract; dropping or rewording AC-2 to reach BUILT is a waiver nobody granted
the passing AC-1 test is traceability evidence; it is kept, not replaced
